rule.calendar_observation: a calendar fact (leader, report date) acts only on decisions taken at or after the run that FIRST RECORDED it (calendar_facts.jsonl, append-only, run stamp); a fact first recorded after the close of its reaction session is LEARNED_LATE and never acts retroactively. Facts recorded by the declaring run have an UNKNOWN observation time (the only pull on record is 2026-11-11); rows decided before the declaration carry calendar_observed: unknown
rule.calendar_stale_rule: a leader is STALE when its newest known report is older than calendar_stale_days at the run, or its calendar pull predates the last session; a step with a STALE leader exits non-zero and names it
rule.definition: at the close of a leader's earnings-reaction session s with open_s / close_(s-1) - 1 <= gap_threshold, stock exposure = gross_after_event for sessions s+1 .. s+sessions_after_event (overlapping events: the minimum)
rule.non_earnings_gaps: do not fire (as the replay code ran; NVDA 11-09 / 11-12 2026 excluded)
rule.reaction_sessions: PIT form: the first session on/after the earnings date AND the session after it; each fires on its own gap. Replay: the larger |gap| of the two (peeks at the next open)
